value.body:
Hi,

I'm new to tangled/knot and I'm trying to setup a new knot2 instance from scratch (no migration) , adapting the docker-compose example and the atcr.io/tangled.org/knot:2 image to my configuration and reverse proxy (traefik)

Everthing seems to be fine (only one warning " tls.http3 is set without any TLS certificate, so HTTP/3 won't start. Configure a static cert or ACME to serve h3. " in the log ) and the knot is verified in my tangled settings.

But I cannot use my own knot where I want to create a repo, I have this error :

"XRPC ERROR 401: AuthenticationRequired: did:plc:mydid doesn't have a DID document, the directory answered HTTP 404"

(and mydid is into the KNOT_SERVER_OWNER env )

Thank for you help if you have an idea !
value.title: Knot v2 authentication error
